simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם (H1021) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם (Bêyth hak-Kerem) means Beth-hak-Kerem , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Jer 6 1.

definitions.full: H1021. Beth Hakkerem הַכֶּ֫רֶם בֵּית proper name, of a location in Judah ( vineyard place ) Jer 6:1 , ׳בּ הַכָּ֫רֶם Neh 3:14 ; on location compare Schick ZPV iii. 83 f. , but see editorial remarks ib. , & Bd Pal 136 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 3754 with the article interposed; house of the vineyard;
